-# How it works
-
-As of 2022-11, the way coverstore works is that new covers that are uploaded to Open Library go into `/1/var/lib/openlibrary/coverstore/localdisk/` within a directory named `/YYYY/MM/DD/`. A record for each cover (and its size variants) is recorded within the `cover` table of the `coverstore` psql db located on `ol-db1`.
-
-At some (presumably advantageous if) regular interval, as the `localdisk` fills, the files can undergo archival, a process whereby covers are compressed and bundled into tar archives which are moved into the `/1/var/lib/openlibrary/coverstore/items/` directory within folders called "staging items" (e.g. `covers_0007`). -The item name itself (e.g. `coverd_0007`) is a combination of the prefix `covers` and the code `web.numify("%010d.jpg" % cover.id)[:4]` where, in this case, `cover.id` is `7315539`. The `"%010d"` format parameter pads the `cover.id` with leading 0's until it is 10 digits long and then the [:4] takes the first 4 digits of this padded number. Anything lower than `cover.id` 1,000,000 will thus be in `covers_0000` and from there the next 1M will be in `covers_0002` and so on. In total, this scheme allows for just under 10B covers before it breaks, which is a sufficiently unlikely number to hit!

+`process_pending` validates staged ZIPs and uploads missing ones. Finalization
+checks all four ZIPs in archive.org, then updates the batch records in one
+transaction. Only after that transaction succeeds does it delete local cover
+files and staged ZIPs. A failed upload or an interrupted run can be retried:
+ZIP members are deduplicated and already uploaded ZIPs are skipped. A lock file
+under `items/.locks/` serializes writers and finalizers for each batch on the
+shared data root. Lock files can remain after completion; the lock itself is
+released when the process exits.
+Finalization writes a source file manifest before changing database URLs, so
+a retry can finish deleting local images after an interrupted cleanup.
+
+Upload and finalization require every existing non-failed cover in the batch
+to be staged and at least one cover ID in a later batch. This keeps the active
+batch open for new covers and avoids publishing an incomplete ZIP.
+
+Historical `.tar` batches and index based reads remain supported by the cover
+server. New batches use only ZIPs. Run
+`migrations/2026-10-17-cover-upload-state.sql` against an existing database
+before using the new process. `schema.sql` and `schema.py` describe new
+databases.
+
+For a historical tar batch already uploaded to archive.org, run
+`archive.Batch(8, 80).reconcile_legacy(test=False)`. This checks all four tar
+and index pairs before changing the archived, non-failed cover records to
+their remote tar member URLs and setting `uploaded=true`. It leaves historical
+tar files on disk for a separate cleanup decision. Batches containing a mix
+of tar records and ZIP staging require manual reconciliation.

+class FakeUploader:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.files = set()
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def is_uploaded(self, item, filename):
+        return (item, filename) in self.files
+
+    def upload(self, item, filepaths):
+        self.calls.append((item, filepaths))
+        self.files.add((item, os.path.basename(filepaths[0])))
+

+def test_stage_upload_and_finalize(archive_db, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    cover_id = 8_800_123
+    filenames = {}
+    for size in archive.SIZES:
+        field = f'filename_{size}' if size else 'filename'
+        suffix = f'-{size.upper()}' if size else ''
+        filenames[field] = f'2026/10/17/test{suffix}.jpg'
+        path = tmp_path / 'localdisk' / filenames[field]
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        path.write_bytes(f'image-{size}'.encode())
+    archive_db.insert('cover', id=cover_id, archived=False, failed=False, uploaded=False, created=datetime(2026, 10, 17), **filenames)
+    # The next batch has started, so this one can be finalized.
+    archive_db.insert('cover', id=8_810_000, archived=True, failed=False, uploaded=True)
+
+    archive.archive(test=False)
+    staged = archive_db.select('cover', where='id=$id', vars={'id': cover_id})[0]
+    assert staged.archived
+    assert not staged.uploaded
+    assert staged.filename == filenames['filename']
+    for size in archive.SIZES:
+        path = archive.Batch.get_abspath(8, 80, size)
+        with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
+            member = f'{cover_id:010d}{"-" + size.upper() if size else ""}.jpg'
+            assert zf.namelist() == [member]
+            assert zf.read(member) == f'image-{size}'.encode()
+            assert zf.getinfo(member).compress_type == zipfile.ZIP_STORED
+
+    uploader = FakeUploader()
+    batch = archive.Batch(8, 80)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='missing uploaded ZIPs'):
+        batch.process_pending(finalize=True, test=False, uploader=uploader)
+    assert not archive_db.select('cover', where='id=$id', vars={'id': cover_id})[0].uploaded
+
+    cleanup = archive.Batch._cleanup_manifest
+
+    def interrupted_cleanup(_batch):
+        raise RuntimeError('interrupted cleanup')
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(archive.Batch, '_cleanup_manifest', interrupted_cleanup)
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match='interrupted cleanup'):
+        batch.process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True, test=False, uploader=uploader)
+    assert (tmp_path / 'localdisk' / filenames['filename']).exists()
+    assert Path(batch._manifest_path()).exists()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(archive.Batch, '_cleanup_manifest', cleanup)
+    batch.process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True, test=False, uploader=uploader)
+    completed = archive_db.select('cover', where='id=$id', vars={'id': cover_id})[0]
+    assert completed.archived
+    assert completed.uploaded
+    for size in archive.SIZES:
+        field = f'filename_{size}' if size else 'filename'
+        assert completed[field] == archive.Cover.get_cover_url(cover_id, size)
+        assert not Path(archive.Batch.get_abspath(8, 80, size)).exists()
+        assert not (tmp_path / 'localdisk' / filenames[field]).exists()
+    assert len(uploader.calls) == 4
+    response = code.app.request(f'/b/id/{cover_id}-M.jpg')
+    assert response.status.startswith('302')
+    assert response.headers['Location'] == archive.Cover.get_cover_url(cover_id, 'm')
+    batch.process_pending(upload=True, finalize=True, test=False, uploader=uploader)
+    assert len(uploader.calls) == 4
+
